title: The Infinytes
description:
The Infinytes is a Minecraft datapack that adds new powerful armors, items, and crafting mechanics using custom entities. All content is survival-friendly and designed to enhance the late-game experience.

---
body:
**Added some super strong armor, items and of course "Survival Friendly"**

---
- “The Infinytes is a survival-friendly datapack that adds dozens of custom items, powerful armors, and crafting mechanics using entity-based traders. Designed to expand late-game progression while remaining compatible with most vanilla features.”

### **WARNING!!**
> This datapack has extreme Ticks Per Second (TPS) optimization, which will delete items more than 5 blocks away and undead more than 10 blocks away every 10 seconds due to the large number of commands running per tick. If we talk about compatibility, this Datapack is indeed compatible with almost all other Datapacks, but it will make your world very laggy.

### **Compatible**
> Minecraft Version 1.21.6+
> 
> can be installed on a multiplayer server
> 
> Vanilla
> 
> no need to use resource pack
